is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis, a member of the Anopheles gambiae complex (page 2, 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (referred to as 1014F) and L995S (referred to as 1014S) (page 3, 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 provides genotype counts (FF, LF, LL) for survivors and dead mosquitoes for permethrin, deltamethrin, and DDT (page 6).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from four sentinel sites in Gezira state, Sudan (page 2, 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collections and laboratory analyses (page 2-4).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study identifies four specific sentinel sites: Wad Medani, Elmanagil, Wad Elhadad, and Rufaa (page 2, 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between October 2008 and January 2011 (page 2, 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and analyses conducted between 2008 and 2011.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in Table 4 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance in Anopheles arabiensis in Gezira state, Sudan, over three years (2008-2011). It found resistance to DDT and pyrethroids, which was significantly associated with the 1014F kdr mutation. Metabolic resistance mechanisms were also investigated via microarray analysis.
